name: YieldFi yUSD
oneLiner: YieldFi yUSD is an ERC-4626 vault over USDC, allocating across Pendle PTs, Morpho and Silo vaults, and private-credit strategies for yield over the dollar.
collateral: USDC deposited into the yUSD ERC-4626 vault and allocated by YieldFi's manager across Pendle principal tokens, Morpho and Silo lending vaults, private-credit positions, and market-neutral/delta-neutral strategies (private LP deals, hedged carry, basis, and funding-rate spreads across whitelisted protocols)
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 share over USDC priced at NAV ((Series Assets - Series Liabilities) / tokens outstanding), valued at least twice weekly using Chainlink oracles; value tracks the dollar through delta-neutral strategy returns rather than direct redemption against fiat reserves

oracleRisk.summary: YieldFi token terms specify Chainlink or equivalent pricing for on-chain assets and a reasonable execution-based fallback during market disruption; yUSD has no borrower-owned collateral or liquidation branches.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: YieldFi defines yUSD as a market-neutral series whose NAV is based on Series Assets and whose collateral and liquidation policies are not applicable. Tokenholders redeem against the series and do not open borrower positions, so there are no yUSD collateral-market or liquidation branches to inventory.

mintAuthority.summary: YieldFi yUSD is an ERC-4626-style USDC strategy vault; wrapper shares mint against USDC deposits or manager calls, while base USDC mint authority is inherited from Circle.

controls.label: YieldFi YToken share minting
controls.capDescription: Verified source mints shares during deposit and permits manager-only mintYToken/burnYToken accounting; it does not mint base USDC.
controls.evidence: Ethereum reads returned asset() = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, implementation 0x5bf44d32260aee6b807c490e92ef0481d15ab493, admin 0xe26e1d2ae51dcb89e382ca7400b080e6632117b9, manager() = 0x03ACc35286bAAE6D73d99a9f14Ef13752208C8dC, and administrator() = 0x10472f91f67C49260BDD65F016ea0757bb1Fc91e. Deposits mint vault shares but do not provide an independent base-USDC mint path.

controls.label: YieldFi Manager runtime share-mint authority (Ethereum)
controls.capDescription: Verified YToken source restricts mintYToken and burnYToken to the configured Manager; the Manager proxy's terminal operator and role configuration are not established.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295175, YToken manager() returned this Manager transparent-proxy address. The verified YToken source permits manager-only mintYToken and burnYToken calls; the current Manager proxy's terminal operator, roles, and any corresponding non-Ethereum authority paths are not established by the reviewed sources.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295175: vault proxy admin (0xe26e1d2ae51dcb89e382ca7400b080e6632117b9, OZ ProxyAdmin) is owned by YieldFiTimelockController (0x8e31efda4453494a84fa6168d53eb1418c0b4ac4) with 1-day minDelay (86400 seconds). The timelock has 0 holders for all roles (PROPOSER, EXECUTOR, DEFAULT_ADMIN), so the observed upgrade path is inactive. Administrator proxy (0x10472...) and Manager proxy (0x03ACc...) ProxyAdmins are also owned by the same timelock. Runtime minting (mintYToken/burnYToken) flows through the Manager contract (TransparentUpgradeableProxy, impl: Manager), but its terminal operator and role configuration cannot be confirmed from the reviewed chain state or issuer materials.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate the Manager proxy's terminal operator and role authority for Ethereum share minting, and establish the corresponding mint authority across each tracked non-Ethereum yUSD deployment.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: YUSD is deployed on many chains and L2BEAT points its route signal at Across. Across is an intent/liquidity framework with non-minting route execution, so Pharos scores this as a liquidity-or-intent route rather than a canonical bridge or issuer-native path. 2026-07-20 cohort dc-1 pass: Ethereum row confirmed native YToken; other-chain rows confirmed YieldFi yUSD LayerZero OFT representations with uniform deployment/admin reads.

reserves.name: USDC active strategy vaults and private-credit positions
reserves.issuerOrObligor: YieldFi yUSD vault, strategy managers, and Circle USDC

reserveReview.rationale: YieldFi identifies yUSD as a USDC-denominated strategy-vault share. The direct reserve envelope is therefore the USDC wrapper exposure, while the manager's active vault, private-credit, and market-neutral deployments remain strategy risk rather than a public current asset allocation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live single-asset strategy row and YieldFi yUSD token terms
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The terms do not publish current allocations across Pendle, Morpho, Silo, private-credit, or market-neutral strategies, nor the related custodian and counterparty weights.
